gap: Package/JVM original exploration context operations had no App service/Fetcher lifecycle consumer; App pause did not request their pending saves.
production: Existing NativeLegadoOriginalPreviewExecutor forwards explore/open/evaluate/savePending through the same process, JVM HTTP and persistent source Host.
Existing context actor tracks only at most 99 immutable source/revision identities; original InfoMap stays in the single Java process LRU99. Explore does not implicitly open a context.
All-open-source pause re-resolves each UUID through the current source index and compares the immutable source signature. Removed/edited/wrong-UUID sources receive no old-revision grant.

Every source save awaits the actual invocation and session close; a failed source is not ACKed and does not stop other independent source saves. Cancellation awaits the current invocation and stops the sweep.

Existing BookSourceFetcher holds one task for App inactive/background. A repeated phase request schedules another sweep after current work; existing BackgroundTaskHold bounds system background allowance without blocking main.
Original explore results use the existing preview record/projection identity, permitting the same details/TOC/content embedding chain without another state or parsing route.
Swift Package exploration APIs now forward optional reported-effects observers so real host effects survive an embedding close error, matching the five existing business calls.

regressionDefinitions.actualJNICasePurpose: Two opened source maps mark save without immediate disk write; real native original explore reads its source map; all-source pause writes through the actual shared cache owner; repeated clean pause leaves cache revisions unchanged; unique controlled cache keys are deleted afterward.
regressionDefinitions.oldFixtureChange: The existing PreviewFixtureExecutor explicitly rejects the four newly added exploration operation cases instead of pretending to grant preview-entity authority.

limits: Current real DiscoverViewModel / DiscoverQuickActionRunner category/button consumers still use their prior JSC route; these explicit original APIs and App pause hook do not claim original UI navigation is selected.

ReaderView SourceCallBackService and ChapterFetchManager default traditional chapter calls still select their existing path. Their original-runtime consumer integration remains required under the original product gate.
The actual JNI case and three coordination cases are definitions only on this Windows host. No Swift compilation, App/Simulator execution or new broad CI was performed.
All-source means the 99 opened contexts known to this actual DI service, not a new global JVM context sweep that bypasses each source Host.
Original per-operation close is the source session close only; it does not delete the process InfoMap. No unsupported clear/close-context operation was invented.
BackgroundTaskHold uses only system-granted time; process suspension/death and long unattended lifecycle behavior remain unverified.
